{{Quote|We cannot blame anyone for the Cathedral's destruction. We understand that it was an accident, and we forgive Admiral Ackbar. While the Cathedral is gone, this is not forever. We will rebuild, and this will be our sole purpose until we can once again play our concert in peace.|[[Krini-shen]] after the Cathedral's destruction|<ref name="COTF43">''[[Champions of the Force]]''</ref>}}
The '''Cathedral of Winds''' was a magnificent, delicate and extremely intricate structure located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vortex/Legends|Vortex]], [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]]-old.
==Function==
It was the focal point of Vortex's annual [[Concert of the Winds/Legends|Concert of the Winds]], a cultural festival to celebrate the planet's changing of seasons. The native [[Vor]]s did not permit any being to record the [[Music/Legends|music]] made by the landmark. As the wind rushed through the countless spires, tunnels and openings, Vors would actually cover certain areas with their own bodies, creating different tunes and songs that they kept memorized in their heads. Each song was known [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-wide for its beauty and uniqueness.
==History==
It became first known outside the planet during the [[Pius Dea Crusades]], when [[Scout/Legends|explorer]] [[Hicco]] discovered the structure. A few centuries later, in [[10,000 BBY]], historian [[Vicendi]] included it in the list of the [[Twenty Wonders of the Galaxy]]. It was considered semi-legendary for the next [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]], until the planet joined the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]  in [[3977 BBY]].<ref>''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

On a diplomatic mission to the planet, [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]] accidentally crashed his personal [[B-wing/E starfighter|B-wing/E-2]] into the cathedral, destroying it and [[Death/Legends|killing]] hundreds of Vors. Ackbar resigned in shame from the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|military]]. Once proven that Ackbar's ship had been [[Saboteur/Legends|sabotaged]] and that the crash was not his fault, Ackbar was reinstated in the military.

Soon after the destruction of the original Cathedral, the Vors began the painstaking work of building a new Cathedral of Winds, which was played for the first time after the destruction of the [[Maw Installation]].<ref name="COTF43" /> [[Qwi Xux]] aided in the rebuilding, using her expertise in [[quantum-crystalline armor]] to help.<ref name="DT211">''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide II: Ruin]]''</ref>
